mentions.name: PitchDance
mentions.description: Vocal pitch-and-time editor similar to Melodyne that works as standalone software or as a plug-in for a DAW. It aims to make pitch-correction software more accessible by selling at a much cheaper price than the major competitors, and the builder is looking for people to test the software with a free license.
mentions.problem: Pitch-correction and pitch/time editing software like Melodyne is priced high by major vendors; PitchDance sells at a much cheaper price to make this kind of software more accessible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a vocal pitch-and-time editor called PitchDance, something like Melodyne. It works both as standalone software or a plug-in for your DAW. The idea is to make software like this more accessible by selling at a much cheaper price than the majors, and only competitors I could find on the market.
mentions.author: Jacques2Marais
